title: Machine learning selects a protein panel that improves myocardial infarction risk prediction
summary: A 23-protein panel raised the C-statistic from 0.710 to 0.733 when added to conventional risk factors in 37,187 UK Biobank participants, including 630 myocardial infarction cases.
organization: China Kadoorie Biobank; University of Oxford; UK Biobank

evidence.tested: The authors report evaluation in Chinese source data and an external UK Biobank cohort.
evidence.unknown: The observational evaluation does not establish causal effects, prospective clinical benefit or readiness for routine testing.
evidence.ai_role: Boruta selected proteins from two proteomics platforms for the prediction panel.
